_comment: Layout, sizing and motion for loading. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror; these do not, so they are authored here.

_source.size-default: Figma component frame is 56x56 — a fixed dimension, no semantic sizing scale exists in design.md
_source.size-sm: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it
_source.size-lg: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it
_source.size-xl: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it
_source.frame-size: Figma inner frame 44.8x44.8 — fixed vector geometry
_source.track-size: Figma track-ring vector bounds — fixed geometry
_source.arc-size: Figma arc vector bounds — fixed geometry
_source.duration: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — design.md has no motion group
_source.timing-function: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — design.md has no motion group
_source.iteration-count: storybook-local, no Figma token backs it — design.md has no motion group
_source.size-sm / size-lg / size-xl: Library additions, not readings. Figma ships one size, 56. These exist because callers need a smaller inline spinner and a larger page-level one; no Figma variant backs any of them.
_source.arc-primary: Read off Figma's `Property 1=Variant2`, which binds `colors/primary/default` on the arc.

_verified_from.node: 22535:131958 — component set `Loading` on page `↳ loading ✅`. The id this file previously carried, 14291:131477, is the `Property 1=Default` variant inside that set — correct but partial.
_verified_from.scope: both variants, exact unrounded geometry, fill opacity and node opacity
_verified_from.result: Frame 56x56, inner 44.8, track vector 41.06668, arc 20.34353 — all match to three decimals. The track is #000000 at fill-opacity 0.8 with node opacity 0.25, so it renders at 20%; the library reaches the same 20% through overlay-heavy (80% black) times track-opacity (25%). Confirmed in the browser: computed fill rgba(0,0,0,0.8) with opacity 0.25.
_verified_from.gap_found: Figma's second variant paints the arc `colors/primary/default`. The library had no equivalent — `arc-primary` and the `tone` prop were added to close it.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. An icon Figma hides by default belongs in `icons` only when this component implements the state that reveals it; otherwise it is recorded under _figma_gaps instead, so the gate is not asking for a feature nobody built.

nodes.note: This component draws no icon at all in Figma. Recorded so that one appearing later has to be justified rather than slipping in.
